technical.summary: Strong overbought momentum with solid trend structure, but divergence between price strength and volume/accumulation metrics creates execution risk; best suited for profit-taking rather than aggressive entry.

fundamental.summary: AMP shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, no government contracts, no lobbying spend, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 79 days present elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals with modest congressional selling activity, fear-zone market conditions offering potential contrarian opportunity, but insufficient conviction and unavailable news sentiment limit actionability.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (274.56) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 79 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 extreme overbought with stochastic bullish cross and price above all major moving averages provides technical momentum setup in fear-zone market conditions offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 274.56), zero fundamental conviction, volume/accumulation divergence (CMF negative, OBV flat, volume ratio 0.56), and earnings event risk in 79 days create execution risk that outweighs technical overbought setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical overbought setup with stochastic bullish cross offers contrarian entry in fear-zone conditions; however, severe macro headwinds and zero fundamental conviction make this a low-probability trade unsuitable for new exposure.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (274.56), and earnings event in 79 days create macro event risk that can trigger sharp reversals despite technical overbought conditions; volume/accumulation divergence signals weak conviction behind price strength.
decision.recommended_exit: If existing position held: trailing_15pct; if new entry forced: atr_trail_1x with hard stop at earnings announcement.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical score (7) insufficient to overcome fundamental (2), sentiment (4), and risk (1) consensus.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding AMP position with 74 existing Financials positions (26% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further; avoid adding to concentration in macro stress environment.
